prompt: My game loses most new players in the first minute. Give me a plan.

recommends a visual/icon cue over text
recommends funnel events or a metric to measure the fix
does not recommend forced long tutorials

says the fix was adding an icon over the pots
says Roblox did not publish the after-fix percentage
